description: This source file implements the StoreValue class, which represents the <store-value> element in the mini-language for Apache OFBiz. It handles storing a specified entity value into the database as part of a mini-language method operation.

classes.name: StoreValue
classes.description: Represents the <store-value> element that stores a value of an entity into the database within a mini-language method.
